sanskrit: te tu tāṃ rajanīm uṣya brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ upatasthur upasthānaṃ saharājapurohitāḥ
english: Having spent that night, the Brāhmaṇas who were masters of the Vedas presented themselves for the morning audience together with the royal chaplain.

sanskrit: amātyā balamukhyāś ca mukhyā ye nigamasya ca rāghavasyābhiṣekārthe prīyamāṇās tu saṃgatāḥ
english: Ministers, commanders of the army, and the leading men of the guilds — all delighted — assembled together for the consecration of Rāghava.

sanskrit: udite vimale sūrye puṣye cābhyāgate 'hani abhiṣekāya rāmasya dvijendrair upakalpitam
english: When the pure sun had risen and the day of the Puṣya asterism had arrived, the foremost twice-born had prepared everything for the consecration of Rāma.

sanskrit: kāñcanā jalakumbhāś ca bhadrapīṭhaṃ svalaṃkṛtam rāmaś ca samyagāstīrṇo bhāsvarā vyāghracarmaṇā
english: Golden water-jars were arrayed, an auspicious throne was richly adorned, and a resplendent tiger-skin had been properly spread upon it for Rāma.

sanskrit: gaṅgāyamunayoḥ puṇyāt saṃgamād āhṛtaṃ jalam yāś cānyāḥ saritaḥ puṇyā hradāḥ kūpāḥ sarāṃsi ca
english: Water had been brought from the sacred confluence of the Gaṅgā and Yamunā, and from other holy rivers, lakes, wells, and ponds.

sanskrit: prāgvāhāś cordhvavāhāś ca tiryagvāhāḥ samāhitāḥ tābhyaś caivāhṛtaṃ toyaṃ samudrebhyaś ca sarvaśaḥ
english: From streams flowing eastward, northward, and laterally, water had been carefully gathered, and likewise from all the oceans.

sanskrit: kṣaudraṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ lājā darbhāḥ sumanasaḥ payaḥ salājāḥ kṣīribhiś channā ghaṭāḥ kāñcanarājatāḥ padmotpalayutā bhānti pūrṇāḥ paramavāriṇā
english: Honey, curds, clarified butter, parched grain, darbha-grass, flowers, and milk — golden and silver jars covered with milk-plants, adorned with lotuses and blue water-lilies, gleamed, filled to the brim with the finest water.

sanskrit: candrāṃśuvikacaprakhyaṃ pāṇḍuraṃ ratnabhūṣitam sajjaṃ tiṣṭhati rāmasya vālavyajanam uttamam
english: A splendid white yak-tail fan, bright as moonbeams, adorned with jewels, stood ready for Rāma.

sanskrit: candramaṇḍalasaṃkāśam ātapatraṃ ca pāṇḍuram sajjaṃ dyutikaraṃ śrīmad abhiṣekapuraskṛtam
english: And a white parasol resembling the orb of the moon — radiant, magnificent, and placed in readiness for the consecration — stood waiting.

sanskrit: pāṇḍuraś ca vṛṣaḥ sajjaḥ pāṇḍurāśvaś ca susthitaḥ prasrutaś ca gajaḥ śrīmān aupavāhyaḥ pratīkṣate
english: A white bull stood ready, a white horse was properly stationed, and a majestic rutting elephant — fit for a king to ride — waited in attendance.

sanskrit: aṣṭau kanyāś ca maṅgalyāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ vāditrāṇi ca sarvāṇi bandinaś ca tathāpare
english: Eight auspicious maidens adorned with all their ornaments, all manner of musical instruments, and likewise bards and panegyrists — all were assembled.

sanskrit: ikṣvākūṇāṃ yathā rājye saṃbhriyetābhiṣecanam tathā jātīyām ādāya rājaputrābhiṣecanam
english: In the manner customary within the kingdom of the Ikṣvākus for a royal consecration, all the prescribed requisites for the anointing of a prince had been assembled.

sanskrit: te rājavacanāt tatra samavetā mahīpatim apaśyanto 'bruvan ko nu rājño naḥ prativedayet
english: Those who had assembled there by the king's command, not seeing the lord of the earth, said among themselves: "Who now will announce us to the king?"

sanskrit: na paśyāmaś ca rājānam uditaś ca divākaraḥ yauvarājyābhiṣekaś ca sajjo rāmasya dhīmataḥ
english: "We do not see the king, yet the sun has risen, and all is prepared for the consecration of wise Rāma as heir-apparent."

sanskrit: iti teṣu bruvāṇeṣu sārvabhaumān mahīpatīn abravīt tān idaṃ sarvān sumantro rājasatkṛtaḥ
english: While they were speaking thus, Sumantra — honoured by the king — addressed all those sovereign lords of the earth with these words.

sanskrit: ayaṃ pṛcchāmi vacanāt sukham āyuṣmatām aham rājñaḥ saṃpratibuddhasya yac cāgamanakāraṇam
english: "On the king's command I shall inquire after the well-being of these long-lived lords, and also after the reason for their coming, once the king has been awakened."

sanskrit: ity uktvāntaḥpuradvāram ājagāma purāṇavit āśīrbhir guṇayuktābhir abhituṣṭāva rāghavam
english: Having said this, the knower of ancient lore went to the inner-palace gate and praised Rāghava with auspicious benedictions full of virtuous import.

sanskrit: gatā bhagavatī rātrirahaḥ śivam upasthitam budhyasva nṛpaśārdūla kuru kāryam anantaram
english: "The blessed night has passed, an auspicious day has come. Awaken, O tiger among kings, and proceed to your duty without delay."

sanskrit: brāhmaṇā balamukhyāś ca naigamāś cāgatā nṛpa darśanaṃ pratikāṅkṣante pratibudhyasva rāghava
english: "Brāhmaṇas, commanders of the army, and the guild-leaders have all come, O king, awaiting your audience. Awaken, O Rāghava."

sanskrit: stuvantaṃ taṃ tadā sūtaṃ sumantraṃ mantrakovidam pratibudhya tato rājā idaṃ vacanam abravīt
english: Having awakened while that charioteer Sumantra, skilled in counsel, was thus praising him, the king then spoke these words.

sanskrit: na caiva saṃprasuto 'ham ānayed āśu rāghavam iti rājā daśarathaḥ sūtaṃ tatrānvaśāt punaḥ
english: "I have not yet slept — bring Rāghava quickly." With these words king Daśaratha once more commanded the charioteer.

sanskrit: sa rājavacanaṃ śrutvā śirasā pratipūjya tam nirjagāma nṛpāvāsān manyamānaḥ priyaṃ mahat
english: Hearing the king's command and honouring it by bowing his head, Sumantra departed from the royal dwelling, thinking this a great favour.

sanskrit: prapanno rājamārgaṃ ca patākā dhvajaśobhitam sa sūtas tatra śuśrāva rāmādhikaraṇāḥ kathāḥ
english: Setting out along the royal road adorned with pennants and banners, that charioteer heard conversations all concerning Rāma.

sanskrit: tato dadarśa ruciraṃ kailāsasadṛśaprabham rāmaveśma sumantras tu śakraveśmasamaprabham
english: Then Sumantra beheld Rāma's beautiful dwelling — radiant as Mount Kailāsa, in splendour equal to the abode of Indra.

sanskrit: mahākapāṭapihitaṃ vitardiśataśobhitam kāñcanapratimaikāgraṃ maṇividrumatoraṇam
english: It was closed by great doors, beautiful with hundreds of terraced pavilions, adorned with golden statues throughout, with arched gateways of gems and coral.

sanskrit: śāradābhraghanaprakhyaṃ dīptaṃ meruguhopamam dāmabhir varamālyānāṃ sumahadbhir alaṃkṛtam
english: White as the thick clouds of autumn, blazing with light, resembling the caverns of Mount Meru, it was adorned with very long garlands of the finest flowers.

sanskrit: sa vājiyuktena rathena sārathir narākulaṃ rājakulaṃ vilokayan tataḥ samāsādya mahādhanaṃ mahat prahṛṣṭaromā sa babhūva sārathiḥ
english: That charioteer, arriving with his horse-yoked chariot and beholding the vast, opulent royal palace crowded with people, was filled with delight — his hair standing on end with joy.

sanskrit: tad adrikūṭācalameghasaṃnibhaṃ mahāvimānottamaveśmasaṃghavat avāryamāṇaḥ praviveśa sārathiḥ prabhūtaratnaṃ makaro yathārṇavam
english: That charioteer entered unimpeded into the palace — resembling mountain-peaks, massive rocks, and clouds, like a great assemblage of the finest mansions, abounding in treasures — as a sea-creature enters the ocean.

sanskrit: sa tad antaḥpuradvāraṃ samatītya janākulam praviviktāṃ tataḥ kakṣyām āsasāda purāṇavit
english: Having passed through the inner-palace gate thronged with people, the knower of ancient lore reached a secluded inner courtyard.

sanskrit: prāsakārmukabibhradbhir yuvabhir mṛṣṭakuṇḍalaiḥ apramādibhir ekāgraiḥ svanuraktair adhiṣṭhitām
english: It was guarded by young men bearing javelins and bows, wearing polished earrings, vigilant, single-minded, and deeply devoted.

sanskrit: tatra kāṣāyiṇo vṛddhān vetrapāṇīn svalaṃkṛtān dadarśa viṣṭhitān dvāri stryadhyakṣān susamāhitān
english: There at the door he saw elderly women superintendents of the inner apartments, wearing ochre robes, holding cane-staffs, richly ornamented, and deeply composed.

sanskrit: te samīkṣya samāyāntaṃ rāmapriyacikīrṣavaḥ sahabhāryāya rāmāya kṣipram evācacakṣire
english: Seeing him approach and wishing to please Rāma, they immediately announced Sumantra to Rāma together with his wife.

sanskrit: prativeditam ājñāya sūtam abhyantaraṃ pituḥ tatraivānāyayām āsa rāghavaḥ priyakāmyayā
english: Learning that the charioteer had been announced as coming from his father within, Rāghava had him brought in at once, out of a desire to do what was pleasing.

sanskrit: taṃ vaiśravaṇasaṃkāśam upaviṣṭaṃ svalaṃkṛtam dādarśa sūtaḥ paryaṅke sauvaṇo sottaracchade
english: The charioteer saw him — resembling Vaiśravaṇa himself, richly adorned — seated on a couch covered with a golden spread and upper cloth.

sanskrit: varāharudhirābheṇa śucinā ca sugandhinā anuliptaṃ parārdhyena candanena paraṃtapam
english: The scorcher of foes was anointed with the most exquisite sandal-paste — pure, fragrant, and the hue of boar's blood.

sanskrit: sthitayā pārśvataś cāpi vālavyajanahastayā upetaṃ sītayā bhūyaś citrayā śaśinaṃ yathā
english: With Sītā standing at his side, yak-tail fan in hand, he was further graced, like the moon attended by the splendid star Citrā.

sanskrit: taṃ tapantam ivādityam upapannaṃ svatejasā vavande varadaṃ bandī niyamajño vinītavat
english: Sumantra, like a trained panegyrist observant of protocol, reverently saluted him — the granter of boons, blazing like the sun in his own radiance.

sanskrit: prāñjalis tu sukhaṃ pṛṣṭvā vihāraśayanāsane rājaputram uvācedaṃ sumantro rājasatkṛtaḥ
english: With hands joined in reverence, after inquiring about his comfort in recreation, sleep, and rest, Sumantra — honoured by the king — said this to the prince.

sanskrit: kausalyā suprabhā deva pitā tvaṃ draṣṭum icchati mahiṣyā saha kaikeyyā gamyatāṃ tatra māciram
english: "O lord, the auspicious Kausalyā and your father wish to see you, together with the queen Kaikeyī. Go there without delay."

sanskrit: evam uktas tu saṃhṛṣṭo narasiṃho mahādyutiḥ tataḥ saṃmānayām āsa sītām idam uvāca ha
english: Thus addressed, that lion among men of great radiance was filled with joy; he then honoured Sītā and spoke to her thus.

sanskrit: devi devaś ca devī ca samāgamya madantare mantreyete dhruvaṃ kiṃ cid abhiṣecanasaṃhitam
english: "O lady, the king and the queen — consulting together in my presence — are surely deliberating something connected with my consecration."

sanskrit: lakṣayitvā hy abhiprāyaṃ priyakāmā sudakṣiṇā saṃcodayati rājānaṃ madarthaṃ madirekṣaṇā
english: "For she — gracious and fair-handed, intoxicating-eyed — having perceived the king's intention and being eager to please me, is urging the king on my behalf."

sanskrit: yādṛśī pariṣat tatra tādṛśo dūta āgataḥ dhruvam adyaiva māṃ rājā yauvarājye 'bhiṣekṣyati
english: "Such is the assembly gathered there, and such is the messenger who has come — the king will certainly consecrate me as heir-apparent this very day."

sanskrit: hanta śīghram ito gatvā drakṣyāmi ca mahīpatiḥ saha tvaṃ parivāreṇa sukham āssva ramasya ca
english: "Come now, I shall go quickly hence and see the lord of the earth. You remain here comfortably with your retinue and rejoice."

sanskrit: patisaṃmānitā sītā bhartāram asitekṣaṇā ādvāram anuvavrāja maṅgalāny abhidadhyuṣī
english: Sītā, honoured by her husband, the dark-eyed lady, followed her lord as far as the door, silently invoking auspicious blessings upon him.

sanskrit: sa sarvān arthino dṛṣṭvā sametya pratinandya ca tataḥ pāvakasaṃkāśam āruroha rathottamam
english: He saw all the petitioners who had gathered, greeted them affectionately, and then mounted his splendid chariot that blazed like fire.

sanskrit: muṣṇantam iva cakṣūṃṣi prabhayā hemavarcasaṃ kareṇuśiśukalpaiś ca yuktaṃ paramavājibhiḥ
english: That chariot seemed to steal away all eyes with its dazzling golden radiance, and was yoked with the finest horses swift as young elephants.

sanskrit: hariyuktaṃ sahasrākṣo ratham indra ivāśugam prayayau tūrṇam āsthāya rāghavo jvalitaḥ śriyā
english: Like thousand-eyed Indra mounting a tawny-horsed chariot, Rāghava blazing with royal splendour swiftly set forth, having taken his seat.

sanskrit: sa parjanya ivākāśe svanavān abhinādayan niketān niryayau śrīmān mahābhrād iva candramāḥ
english: Resounding like a rain-cloud in the sky, the illustrious Rāma emerged from his dwelling as the moon issues from a great cloud.

sanskrit: chatracāmarapāṇis tu lakṣmaṇo rāghavānujaḥ jugopa bhrātaraṃ bhrātā ratham āsthāya pṛṣṭhataḥ
english: Lakṣmaṇa, the younger brother of Rāghava, parasol and yak-tail fan in hand, mounted the chariot and guarded his brother from behind.

sanskrit: tato halahalāśabdas tumulaḥ samajāyata tasya niṣkramamāṇasya janaughasya samantataḥ
english: Then a great tumultuous roar arose on all sides from the multitude of people as he came forth.

sanskrit: sa rāghavas tatra kathāpralāpaṃ śuśrāva lokasya samāgatasya ātmādhikārā vividhāś ca vācaḥ prahṛṣṭarūpasya pure janasya
english: Rāghava heard there the conversations and talk of the assembled people, and the varied utterances — extolling him — of the joyful citizens of the city.

sanskrit: eṣa śriyaṃ gacchati rāghavo 'dya rājaprasādād vipulāṃ gamiṣyan ete vayaṃ sarvasamṛddhakāmā yeṣām ayaṃ no bhavitā praśāstā lābho janasyāsya yad eṣa sarvaṃ prapatsyate rāṣṭram idaṃ cirāya
english: "Today Rāghava, by the king's favour, is going to receive immense prosperity. We — whose ruler this one will be — are all our desires fulfilled. It is the gain of these people that he will obtain this entire kingdom for a long time."

sanskrit: sa ghoṣavadbhiś ca hayaiḥ sanāgaiḥ puraḥsaraiḥ svastikasūtamāgadhaiḥ mahīyamānaḥ pravaraiś ca vādakair abhiṣṭuto vaiśravaṇo yathā yayau
english: Accompanied by resonant-sounding horses and elephants preceding him, honoured by svastika-reciters, bards, and panegyrists, praised by the finest musicians, he proceeded like Vaiśravaṇa himself.

sanskrit: kareṇumātaṅgarathāśvasaṃkulaṃ mahājanaughaiḥ paripūrṇacatvaram prabhūtaratnaṃ bahupaṇyasaṃcayaṃ dadarśa rāmo ruciraṃ mahāpatham
english: Rāma beheld the beautiful great highway — teeming with she-elephants, bull-elephants, chariots, and horses, with its open spaces filled by great crowds of people, abounding in treasures and extensive stores of merchandise.

sanskrit: sa rāmo ratham āsthāya saṃprahṛṣṭasuhṛjjanaḥ apaśyan nagaraṃ śrīmān nānājanasamākulam
english: Illustrious Rāma, having mounted his chariot, with friends and well-wishers delighted around him, gazed upon the city thronged with multitudes of various people.

sanskrit: sa gṛhair abhrasaṃkāśaiḥ pāṇḍurair upaśobhitam rājamārgaṃ yayau rāmo madhyenāgarudhūpitam
english: Rāma proceeded along the royal road, beautiful with white houses resembling clouds, and perfumed throughout with the smoke of burning agaru wood.

sanskrit: śobhamānam asaṃbādhaṃ taṃ rājapatham uttamam saṃvṛtaṃ vividhaiḥ paṇyair bhakṣyair uccāvacair api
english: That excellent royal road was brilliant and unobstructed, filled with various wares and with foods of every kind, both fine and coarse.

sanskrit: āśīrvādān bahūñ śṛṇvan suhṛdbhiḥ samudīritān yathārhaṃ cāpi saṃpūjya sarvān eva narān yayau
english: Hearing many benedictions voiced by his well-wishers, and honouring all men as befitted them, he rode on.

sanskrit: pitāmahair ācaritaṃ tathaiva prapitāmahaiḥ adyopādāya taṃ mārgam abhiṣikto 'nupālaya
english: "The path that was walked by your grandfathers and great-grandfathers — take it up from this day forward, once consecrated, and guard it well."

sanskrit: yathā sma lālitāḥ pitrā yathā pūrvaiḥ pitāmahaiḥ tataḥ sukhataraṃ sarve rāme vatsyāma rājani
english: "As we were cherished by your father, as by the grandfathers of old — even more happily shall we all dwell under Rāma as our king."

sanskrit: alam adya hi bhuktena paramārthair alaṃ ca naḥ yathā paśyāma niryāntaṃ rāmaṃ rājye pratiṣṭhitam
english: "Enough today with eating, enough with all our other concerns — so long as we can see Rāma riding forth, established in his kingdom."

sanskrit: ato hi na priyataraṃ nānyat kiṃ cid bhaviṣyati yathābhiṣeko rāmasya rājyenāmitatejasaḥ
english: "For nothing shall be dearer to us, nor shall any other thing equal it, than the consecration of Rāma of boundless glory to his kingdom."

sanskrit: etāś cānyāś ca suhṛdām udāsīnaḥ kathāḥ śubhāḥ ātmasaṃpūjanīḥ śṛṇvan yayau rāmo mahāpatham
english: Hearing these and other such auspicious words from well-wishers — words that honoured him personally — Rāma rode with equanimity along the great highway.

sanskrit: na hi tasmān manaḥ kaś cic cakṣuṣī vā narottamāt naraḥ śaknoty apākraṣṭum atikrānte 'pi rāghave
english: For no person could turn either mind or eyes away from that best of men, even after Rāghava had passed by.

sanskrit: sarveṣāṃ sa hi dharmātmā varṇānāṃ kurute dayām caturṇāṃ hi vayaḥsthānāṃ tena te tam anuvratāḥ
english: For that righteous-souled one shows compassion to all the four varṇas and to all four stages of life; therefore they were all devoted to him.

sanskrit: sa rājakulam āsādya mahendrabhavanopamam rājaputraḥ pitur veśma praviveśa śriyā jvalan
english: Reaching the royal palace — comparable to the abode of great Indra — that prince, blazing with royal splendour, entered his father's dwelling.

sanskrit: sa sarvāḥ samatikramya kakṣyā daśarathātmajaḥ saṃnivartya janaṃ sarvaṃ śuddhāntaḥpuram abhyagāt
english: Having passed through all the courtyards, that son of Daśaratha dismissed all his attendants and proceeded to the pure inner apartments.

sanskrit: tataḥ praviṣṭe pitur antikaṃ tadā janaḥ sa sarvo mudito nṛpātmaje pratīkṣate tasya punaḥ sma nirgamaṃ yathodayaṃ candramasaḥ saritpatiḥ
english: Then, after the prince had entered his father's presence, all that joyful multitude waited for his re-emergence, as the ocean awaits the rising of the moon.
